blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments.
However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions.
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student’s current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness.
We introduce ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning.
A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals.
ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework.
On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 1.9 and 4.1 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time guidance through online self-distillation for CUAs.
blocks.zh:
在线培训使计算机使用代理人能够通过与可执行环境的互动而改进。
然而,现有方法主要依靠微薄的结果回报,对中间行动没有监督。
政策上的自我消化(OPSD)通过特权重评提供象征性的学习信号,但直接应用到CUA在线培训中带来了两个挑战:固定指导可能与学生的当前状态错配,而引导引发的概率转移可能与步级正确性冲突.
我们引入了计算机SD(ComputerSD),这是CUA的在线自我消化方法,将执行的GUI过渡的实时反馈转换为政策学习指南.
微调的GUI分析器在每次动作后都会产生引导和继位值分数;引导提供了特权上下文,而分数则调节由此产生的OPSD信号.
计算机 SD在一个完全同步的训练框架内联合优化了符号级OPSD和轨迹级GPRO.
在OSWorld-Verification上,计算机化SD在通用的Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking和专用的EvoCUA-8B骨干上分别以1.9个百分点和4.1个百分点的成绩超过只见成果的GPRO. 在分配外环境下的评价进一步支持了ComputerSD的通用性. 这些结果表明,通过对海关总署的在线自我消化,从实时指导中学习是有效的。

导言

blocks.en:
Developing computer-use agents (CUAs) capable of operating graphical user interfaces (GUIs) is an essential step toward autonomous computer use ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
To bridge the gap between offline demonstrations and real-world interaction, recent studies have increasingly turned to online training in interactive environments ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) .
These methods rely primarily on outcome rewards produced by environment verifiers.
Such rewards indicate whether a task is completed but not which of the many actions in an episode were productive, redundant, or erroneous, making credit assignment a persistent challenge in online CUA training ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
开发能够操作图形用户界面的计算机使用代理(CUAs)是实现计算机自主使用的必要步骤(秦等人,2025年;王等人,2025年b;徐等人,2025年)。
为了弥合离线演示与现实世界互动之间的差距,最近的研究越来越多地转向互动环境中的在线培训(Wang等人,2025a); Zhou等人,2025年;Lai等人,2026年;Lu等人,2025年).
这些方法主要依靠环境核查者产生的结果奖励。
这种奖励表明一项任务是否已经完成,但在一集中的许多行动中,哪些是生产性的、多余的或错误的,使得信用分配成为CUA在线培训中的一个长期挑战(Chen等人,2025年;Feng等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), recently extended to multi-turn agents ( Lu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , recovers this fine-grained credit at the token level ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) : the policy rescores its own sampled response under privileged information such as a reference trajectory or task-relevant skills ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , and the resulting log-probability shifts serve as supervision on which tokens to reinforce or suppress.
blocks.zh: 政策自我消化(OPSD),最近扩大到多回合代理(Lu等人,2026a); Yang等人, 2026年;Wu等人, 2026年),在象征性层面上收回这一精细的信用(Zhao等人, 2026年;Hübotter等人, 2026年):政策在参考轨迹或任务相关技能等特权信息下,将自己的抽样答复重新计分(Wang等人, 2026年a; Lu et al., 2026b ),以及由此产生的日志概率变化,作为加强或压制标志物的监督.

blocks.en:
Applying OPSD to online CUA training, however, raises two problems, illustrated in Figure 1 a.
The first problem is that privileged information fixed before the rollout becomes misaligned with the student’s state.
A CUA task usually admits multiple valid solutions, and once the student leaves the path that a reference trajectory or pre-written guidance assumes, the guidance no longer matches the observed state ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) .
Distilling toward such guidance then suppresses the tokens of steps that are correct on the student’s own path (Figure 1 b).
The second problem is that the token-level signals are unreliable even when the guidance is relevant.
Guidance shifts the probability of every token in the response, and the shift at a given token need not agree with whether the step was correct: over 80% of tokens at correct steps are suppressed and nearly 20% of tokens at incorrect ones are reinforced throughout training (Figure 1 c).
Without regulation, these signals would pull the policy away from the task objective.
blocks.zh:
然而,将OPSD应用于在线CUA培训引起了两个问题,如图1a所示。
第一个问题是,在推出前确定的特殊信息与学生状况不符。
CUA任务通常承认多种有效解决方案,一旦学生离开参考轨迹或预写指南所假定的路径,该指南就不再与观测状态相符(Shenfeld等人,2026年;Harne等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年b).
向这种指导倾斜,然后压制学生自己道路上正确步骤的象征(图1b)。
第二个问题是,即使指导相关,象征级信号也不可靠.
指导会改变响应中每个信物的概率,特定信物的转变不需要同意该步骤是否正确:正确步骤的80%以上的信物被压制,错误步骤的近20%信物在整个训练过程中得到加强(图1c).
没有监管,这些信号将使政策偏离任务目标。

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that the real-time observation after each action can resolve both problems at once.
Once an action is executed, its consequence appears on the next screen, and feedback written from this transition, which we call real-time feedback , describes exactly the state the student reached and removes the misalignment.
The same feedback can also judge whether the action was correct, so the signal that constructs the privileged context can also decide how far to trust the token-level supervision it induces .
Recent work likewise conditions the teacher on the post-action observation ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , but stops at state matching, which still leaves the induced shifts unreliable. We additionally use the feedback’s own judgment of the step to regulate every token-level signal it produces.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要见解是,每次行动之后的实时观察可以同时解决这两个问题。
一旦一个动作被执行,其后果出现在下一个屏幕上,我们称之为实时反馈的这一过渡的反馈,准确地描述了学生到达的状态,并移除了错位.
同样的反馈也可以判断行动是否正确,因此构建特权背景的信号也可以决定它引发的象征级监督的可信度.
最近的工作同样使教师具备了行动后观察的条件(Liu等人,2026a); Li等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b),但停留在状态比对上,这仍然使诱导的转向不可靠. 我们利用反馈本身对这个步骤的判断来调节它产生的每一个象征性信号。

blocks.en:
Building on this insight, we propose ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method that converts real-time feedback into value-gated token-level supervision (Figure 2 ).
After each action, a GUI analyzer reads the screenshots before and after it and returns a step-level value score together with guidance on what to do and what to avoid from the pre-action state; since the untuned policy often misjudges GUI transitions, we fine-tune the analyzer on expert annotations.
The guidance then serves as the privileged context for rescoring, and a value gate weights each token’s shift by its agreement with the value score.
We optimize this token-level objective jointly with trajectory-level GRPO, so that step-level feedback refines credit within each episode while outcome rewards keep learning anchored to task success.
To prevent per-step analysis from stalling rollout, we design a fully asynchronous pipeline for ComputerSD.
blocks.zh:
基于这一见解,我们提议使用计算机自失能(ComputerSD)这一在线自失能方法,将实时反馈转换成以价值表示的代号级监督(图2 ).
每次动作后,一个GUI分析器会读取它前后的截图,并返回一个阶梯级值分,同时给出如何行动以及从动作前状态中避免什么的指引;由于未调整的政策常常会错误地判断GUI的过渡,所以我们在专家说明上微调分析器.
然后,指导成为重评的特权背景,而价值门则通过同意价值分数来权衡每个符号的转变。
我们与轨迹级GRPO一起优化这一象征级目标,这样一步级反馈就能在每集中完善信用,而成果奖励则不断学习,以完成任务。
为了防止逐步分析延缓推出,我们为ComputerSD设计了一个完全同步的管道.

blocks.en:
On OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO on both the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and the computer-use model EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , raising the success rate from 37.9% to 39.8% and from 43.8% to 47.9%.
The gains are largest on application categories held out from training (from 21.6% to 27.5% and from 30.2% to 34.9%), indicating that the step-level supervision transfers beyond the training distribution.
Ablations mirror the two failures identified above: either replacing real-time feedback with fixed guidance or removing the value gate drops performance below GRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, demonstrating the necessity of our design.
Finally, the asynchronous pipeline raises training throughput fivefold over its synchronous counterpart, keeping per-step feedback affordable.
blocks.zh:
在OSWorld-Verification上(谢等人,2024年),计算机 SD在通用的Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking(Bai等人,2025年)和计算机使用模型EvoCUA-8B(Xue等人,2026年)上都超过了只取得结果的GPRO,成功率从37.9%提高到39.8%,从43.8%提高到47.9%。
从培训中获得的应用类别收益最大(从21.6%到27.5%,从30.2%到34.9%),这表明分级监督转移超出了培训分配范围。
偏差反射上述两个失败:要么用固定的导线取代实时反馈,要么在Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking上去掉GRPO以下的值门性能,表明我们设计的必要性.
最后,同步管道将培训吞吐量提高5倍于同步管道,使每步反馈都负担得起。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method in which a fine-tuned GUI analyzer writes real-time feedback after each action and a value gate weights each token-level signal by its agreement with the analyzer’s judgment of the step. • We develop a fully asynchronous training pipeline that overlaps environment interaction, GUI analysis, privileged rescoring, and policy optimization, so that rollout workers keep collecting trajectories while each executed step is analyzed and rescored. • We show on OSWorld-Verified with two 8B backbones with different levels of computer-use specialization that ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO, and that removing either real-time feedback or the value gate lowers performance below GRPO.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议使用计算机系统(ComputerSD)这一在线自我消化方法,由精细的GUI分析器在每次动作后写出实时反馈,而价值门通过同意分析器对步骤的判断,对每个符号级信号进行加权。 我们开发了一个完全同步的训练管道,它与环境互动、GUI分析、特权评分和政策优化相重叠,从而使推出人员不断收集轨迹,同时对每个执行步骤进行分析和重新计分。 我们在 OSWorld-Verifed 上显示,两个8B主干线具有不同的计算机使用专业水平,计算机数据交换系统比只执行结果的GRPO要好,删除实时反馈或值门会降低GRPO以下的性能.

blocks.en: We propose ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method in which a fine-tuned GUI analyzer writes real-time feedback after each action and a value gate weights each token-level signal by its agreement with the analyzer’s judgment of the step.
blocks.zh: 我们提议电脑SD(ComputerSD)是一种在线自我消化方法,其中微调的GUI分析器在每次动作后都会写出实时反馈,价值门通过同意分析器对步骤的判断来权衡每个符号级信号。

blocks.en: We develop a fully asynchronous training pipeline that overlaps environment interaction, GUI analysis, privileged rescoring, and policy optimization, so that rollout workers keep collecting trajectories while each executed step is analyzed and rescored.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个完全同步的训练管道,它重叠了环境互动,GUI分析,特权评分,以及政策优化,这样,推出的员工在每一个执行的步子被分析并重新计分时,都会不断收集轨迹.

blocks.en: We show on OSWorld-Verified with two 8B backbones with different levels of computer-use specialization that ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO, and that removing either real-time feedback or the value gate lowers performance below GRPO.

2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent CUAs improve by scaling verifiable training tasks ( Xue et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) and by online reinforcement learning in executable environments, where ComputerRL and UI-TARS-2 run rollouts over parallel environments ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) and DART decouples rollout from training ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
To supervise intermediate steps, GUI-Shepherd learns a process reward model ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and GiGPO estimates step-level advantages from repeated states ( Feng et al., 2025 ) ; both assign a single scalar to each step.
ComputerSD instead turns the feedback on each executed step into token-level supervision, and its asynchronous pipeline overlaps this analysis with rollout and training.
blocks.zh:
通过扩大可核查的培训任务(Xue等人,2026年;Lv等人,2026年)和通过在可执行环境中的在线强化学习,最近CUAA有所改进,在这种环境中,ComputerRL和UI-TARS-2在平行环境中展开(Lai等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a)和DART脱钩课程(Li等人,2025年)。
为了监督中间步骤,GUI-Shepherd学习了一个过程奖励模型(Chen等人,2025年),GIGPO估计从重复状态(Feng等人,2025年)得到的步级优势;两者都为每个步骤分配一个单级.
计算机数据交换系统将每个执行步骤的反馈转化为符号级监督,其同步的管道将这一分析与推出和培训相重叠。

blocks.en:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) obtains a teacher by conditioning the policy on privileged information and distills its token-level predictions on the policy’s own samples ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) .
For multi-turn agents, OPID and SEED derive this information from completed trajectories ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , and SDAR gates the resulting signals by the teacher–student gap ( Lu et al., 2026a ) .
Because information fixed in advance can mismatch the states the student reaches, HERO conditions the teacher on a diagnosis of the observation after each action ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and GHD and OpenClaw-RL bring this idea to GUI agents via the next screenshot and via hints from a prompted judge ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
ComputerSD obtains both the guidance and a step-level judgment from a fine-tuned GUI analyzer and gates each token-level signal by this judgment, a check at the level of the step rather than of the teacher–student gap or the trajectory outcome ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
政策上的自我消化(OPSD)通过调整特权信息政策获得一位教师,并提取其对政策本身样本的象征性预测(Agarwal等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2026年;Hübotter等人,2026年)。
对于多转子剂,OPID和SEED从完成的轨迹(Yang等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年)中获取这一信息,SDAR将师生产生的信号打开(Lu等人,2026a年)。
由于事先确定的信息可能与学生达到的状态不符,HERO在每次行动(Liu et al., 2026a)之后对老师的观察进行诊断,而GHD和OpenClaw-RL通过下一个截图和一个被敦促的法官的提示将这个想法带到GUI代理(Li等人, 2026年;Wang等人, 2026年b).
计算机 SD从精细的GUI分析器获得指导和阶梯级判断,并通过这个判断将每个符号级的信号打开,在阶梯级别而不是师生差距或轨迹结果的检查(Lin等人,2026年).
3 方法

blocks.en: We present ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method for computer-use agents. As illustrated in Figure 2 , ComputerSD first samples multiple trajectories through online interaction with parallel computer environments, followed by a GUI analyzer that provides step-level guidance based on the interaction process, which is then used to value-gate the token-level reward signals and control their strength according to the step-level value. Finally, the resulting token-level signals are combined with environment rewards to optimize the policy model.
blocks.zh: 我们提出计算机开发公司(ComputerSD), 一种计算机使用代理人的在线自我消化方法。 如图2所示,ComputerSD首先通过与平行计算机环境的在线互动对多个轨迹进行抽样,然后是GUI分析器,根据交互过程提供阶梯级指导,然后用于给符号级奖励信号进行估值,并根据阶梯级值控制其强度. 最后,由此产生的象征性信号与环境奖励相结合,以优化政策模式。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of ComputerSD. The base policy samples trajectories online, while a GUI analyzer provides step-level value scores and guidance. Privileged rescoring produces token-level supervision, which is combined with trajectory-level GRPO to update the policy.

3.2 图形用户界面分析器监督精细调试

blocks.en: To turn step-level environment feedback into structured, learnable signals for online policy training, we train a lightweight GUI analyzer that analyzes GUI transitions to provide real-time feedback.
blocks.zh: 为了将阶梯级环境反馈转化为结构化的,可学习的在线政策培训信号,我们培训一个轻量级的GUI分析器,分析GUI的过渡,以提供实时反馈.

blocks.en: We first collect trajectories on a subset of OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) using a base policy π ϕ \pi_{\phi} . For each task, the policy samples K K trajectories, yielding a diverse pool of successful and unsuccessful interactions with varied action choices, state transitions, and failure modes. These trajectories provide the step contexts for subsequent expert annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用一个基础政策收集OSWorld的子集(Xie等人,2024年)上的轨迹。 对于每一项任务,政策都对K K的轨迹进行抽样,产生了各种成功和不成功的相互作用,包括不同的行动选择、状态过渡和失败模式。 这些轨迹为随后的专家注释提供了步骤背景.

4 实验
4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We initialize the GUI analyzer from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and use Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) as the expert model to annotate the collected trajectories. We then apply ComputerSD to two 8B-scale models: a general-purpose model Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and a specialized model EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) . This allows us to assess ComputerSD’s effectiveness across policies with different levels of computer-use specialization.
blocks.zh: 我们从Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking(Bai等人,2025年)初始化GUI分析器,并使用Kimi-K3(Kimi Team等人,2026年)作为专家模型,对收集的轨迹进行注释. 然后,我们将计算机化应用到两个8B级模型:通用模型Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking(Bai等人,2025年)和专用模型EvoCUA-8B(薛等人,2026年). 这使得我们可以评估计算机数据交换系统在不同水平的计算机使用专门化政策之间的有效性。

blocks.en: We conduct online training on OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , excluding tasks in the Multiple Apps and Chrome categories for out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation. The evaluation set contains 222 in-domain tasks and 139 OOD tasks. We further evaluate the cross-platform generalization of ComputerSD on WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) . For both benchmarks, we report task success rates determined by their official environment verifiers.

4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the performance of ComputerSD alongside representative proprietary and open-source models on OSWorld-Verified. For each backbone, we compare ComputerSD with outcome-only GRPO under the same online training and evaluation settings. The results show that ComputerSD outperforms GRPO on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, ComputerSD achieves a success rate of 39.8 % 39.8\% , exceeding GRPO by 1.9 1.9 points. The gain is larger on the specialized model EvoCUA-8B, where ComputerSD reaches 47.9 % 47.9\% and outperforms GRPO by 4.1 4.1 points. This further improvement suggests that token-level supervision derived from real-time guidance remains effective even after computer-use-specific post-training. Additionally, EvoCUA-8B trained with ComputerSD surpasses all listed open-source models and most listed proprietary models, demonstrating the effectiveness of ComputerSD.
blocks.zh: 表1列示了计算机开发公司在OSWorld-Verified上与代表性专有和开源模型并列的性能. 对于每个骨干,我们根据相同的在线培训和评价环境,将计算机可持续发展与只取得成果的GPRO进行比较。 结果显示,计算机SD在两个骨干上的表现都超过了GPRO. 在Quen3-VL-8B-Thinking上,ComputerSD成功率达到39.8%39.8\%,超过GRPO1.9分. 在专业型号EvoCUA-8B上,增益更大,其中ComputerSD达到47.9%的47.9\%,成绩超过GRPO4.1分. 这一进一步改进表明,即使在计算机使用特定培训后,实时指导产生的象征性监督仍然有效。 此外,EvoCUA-8B在计算机数据化培训中超过了所有列出的开源模型和大多数列出的专有模型,证明了计算机数据化的有效性.

blocks.en: We further evaluate generalization on the held-out categories of OSWorld-Verified and the cross-platform benchmark WindowsAgentArena (WAA). As shown in Table 2 , outcome-only GRPO improves in-domain performance but degrades OOD performance relative to the base models on both backbones. In contrast, ComputerSD consistently improves in-domain and OOD performance on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, ComputerSD outperforms GRPO by 5.9 5.9 points on the held-out categories and 1.2 1.2 points on WAA. On EvoCUA-8B, the corresponding gains are 5.2 5.2 and 3.6 3.6 points, respectively. These results suggest that ComputerSD does not merely fit the training tasks but internalizes real-time feedback into the policy improvements that can generalize to unseen scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价OSWorld-Verifed和跨平台基准WindowsAgentArena(WAA)的搁置类别。 如表2所示,仅注重结果的GRPO可以改善域内性能,但相对于两个主干线上的基础模型可以降低OOD性能. 相比之下,ComputerSD在两个骨干上都不断提高域内和OOD性能. 在Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking上,ComputerSD在被搁置类别上比GRPO的成绩高出5.9分,在WAA上则高出1.2分. 在EvoCUA-8B上,相应的增益分别为5.2.5.2和3.63.6分. 这些结果表明,计算机可持续发展系统不仅适合培训任务,而且将实时反馈纳入政策改进中,从而可以概括到看不见的情况。

blocks.en: We examine how the performance of outcome-only GRPO and ComputerSD evolves throughout online training. As shown in Figure 4 , ComputerSD maintains higher success rates than outcome-only GRPO throughout most of the training process on both backbones. ComputerSD reaches the final GRPO performance after approximately 100 policy updates on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and 40 on EvoCUA-8B. With the same number of sampled trajectories per update, ComputerSD uses only about 56 % 56\% and 22 % 22\% of GRPO’s trajectory budget, respectively, to reach the same performance. This faster improvement suggests that real-time guidance helps the policy learn more from online interactions.

blocks.en: To evaluate the efficiency of the asynchronous training framework, we record the number of trajectories processed per hour throughout training. As shown in Figure 5 , asynchronous GRPO and ComputerSD stabilize at approximately 370 and 210 trajectories per hour, respectively. ComputerSD retains about 57 % 57\% of the throughput of outcome-only GRPO, with the additional cost arising from GUI analyzer queries and privileged rescoring after each executed step. By overlapping the pipeline stages, our asynchronous framework achieves five times the training throughput of synchronous ComputerSD.

4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking to examine the core components of ComputerSD. Table 3 reports the performance of each ablated variant on OSWorld-Verified, while Figure 6 shows how the teacher–student gap varies throughout training.
blocks.zh: 我们进行关于Qune3-VL-8B-思辨的研究,以检查ComputerSD的核心组件. 表3汇报了OSWorld-Verific化上每个被放大的变体的性能,图6显示了教师-学生之间在整个培训过程中的差异。

blocks.en: Directly using the vanilla Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking model as the GUI analyzer reduces the success rate by 1.8 1.8 percentage points. The base model has limited ability to interpret GUI transitions: its teacher–student gap remains at a low level throughout training, indicating that its guidance has limited effects. SFT helps the analyzer learn from expert annotations to provide more effective real-time feedback. Further analysis and evaluation of GUI analyzer SFT are provided in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 直接使用香草Qwen3-VL-8B-思维模型作为GUI分析器将成功率降低1.8 1.8个百分点. 基础模型解释GUI过渡的能力有限:其师生差距在整个培训期间仍然很低,表明其指导效果有限。 SFT帮助分析员学习专家说明,以提供更有效的实时反馈. 对GUI分析器SFT的进一步分析和评价载于附录C.3。

blocks.en: Replacing real-time feedback with fixed privileged guidance reduces the success rate by 4.8 4.8 percentage points. Fixed guidance can become misaligned with the agent’s actual state and may mislead it. The teacher–student gap fluctuates sharply without converging during training, reflecting the instability of this guidance. Real-time feedback avoids this mismatch by deriving each distillation signal from the executed action and resulting environment observation.
blocks.zh: 用固定的特权指导取代实时反馈,成功率降低4.84.8个百分点. 固定指导可能与代理人的实际状态相混淆,并可能误导代理人。 师生差距在培训期间剧烈波动而不趋同,这反映了这一指导的不稳定性。 实时反馈通过从已执行的动作和由此产生的环境观测中得出每个蒸馏信号来避免这种不匹配.

blocks.en: Removing the value gate reduces the success rate by 3.2 3.2 percentage points. The teacher–student gap remains large without converging during training, suggesting that guidance-induced OPSD signals are not uniformly reliable. Without regulating their strength, the student can no longer distinguish useful, goal-aligned guidance from noisy or harmful signals, resulting in degraded performance. 4.5 分析

blocks.en: Table 4 compares our value gate with three alternatives, showing that how OPSD signals are regulated substantially affects policy improvement. The SDAR gate ( Lu et al., 2026a ) consistently attenuates negative probability shifts for conservative token-level supervision. This can leave undesirable sampled actions insufficiently corrected, particularly when the student policy is weak, slowing improvement. The hard value gate replaces the sigmoid with a binary step function, removing signals that conflict with the step-level value judgment and assigning full weight to aligned signals. This aggressive filtering may overfit to the guidance-conditioned teacher distribution and impair generalization, yielding a 4.6 4.6 -point drop in overall success rate.
blocks.zh: 表4将我们的值门与三种替代方法进行比较,表明OPSD信号如何受到管制会大大影响政策的改进。 SDAR门(Lu等人,2026年a)持续减轻保守信使级监督的负概率转移。 这可能使不可取的抽样行动得不到充分的纠正,特别是在学生政策薄弱、改善缓慢的情况下。 硬值门用二进制阶函数取代sigmoid,去除与阶值判断相冲突的信号,并给对齐信号分配全权重. 这种积极的过滤可能过度适应指导性教师分配,并妨碍普及,导致总体成功率下降4.6点。

blocks.en: The reverse value gate assigns larger weights to shifts that conflict with the step-level value judgment. As shown in Figure 8 , its teacher–student gap increases during training, while policy entropy declines. This pattern suggests that the student moves away from the teacher-supported distribution while becoming increasingly self-confident. In contrast, our value gate narrows the gap and avoids the entropy decline, supporting the alignment of OPSD signals with step-level value judgments.
blocks.zh: 反向值门会分配更大的权重来进行与阶级值判断相冲突的移位. 如图8所示,其师生差距在培训期间有所扩大,而政策方面则有所下降。 这种模式表明,学生脱离了教师支持的分配,同时越来越自信。 相比之下,我们的价值门缩小了差距,避免了 en的下降,支持了OPSD信号与阶值判断的对齐.

5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method that converts real-time feedback from GUI transitions into policy updates for CUAs. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value judgment from each executed action; the guidance supplies privileged context, while the value judgment gates the resulting token-level OPSD signals. ComputerSD combines this objective with trajectory-level GRPO and conducts online training in a fully asynchronous framework. On OSWorld-Verified, it outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 1.9 and 4.1 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose and specialized backbones, respectively. It also improves performance on held-out categories and cross-platform scenarios for both backbones. Ablations further support the roles of real-time guidance and value gating. Our studies show that feedback from ongoing GUI interaction can provide effective fine-grained supervision beyond sparse task outcomes, offering a practical path toward online self-distillation for CUAs.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ComputerSD,一种在线自我消化方法,将GUI过渡的实时反馈转换为CUA的政策更新. 一个微调的图形用户界面分析器从每个执行的动作中产生指导和一个阶梯级值判断;该指导提供了特权上下文,而值判断则将由此产生的符号级OPSD信号锁定. ComputerSD将这一目标与轨迹级GPRO相结合,并在完全同步的框架内进行在线培训. 在 " OSWorld-Virific化 " 上,它在普通用途骨干和专门骨干上的业绩分别比 " GPRO " 高1.9和4.1个百分点。 它还改进了两个主干部门在搁置类别和跨平台情景方面的业绩。 缩写进一步支持了实时引导和价值定位的作用. 我们的研究表明,目前GUI互动的反馈可以提供有效的精细监督,超越零星的任务结果,为CUA提供在线自我消化的实用途径.

blocks.en: ComputerSD relies on the reliability of the GUI analyzer, which provides both privileged guidance for self-distillation and step-level value judgments for gating the resulting supervision. Errors in either output can distort the OPSD signal, and the value gate cannot fully resolve this issue when both outputs are unreliable. Our design therefore balances feedback reliability against the cost of expert model calls: a fine-tuned GUI analyzer substantially reduces the cost of obtaining feedback while retaining strong reliability, as discussed in Appendix C.3 . Moreover, OPSD serves as an auxiliary objective alongside trajectory-level GRPO, with its contribution controlled by a small loss coefficient. This reduces the influence of occasional unreliable feedback on overall optimization, although systematic analyzer errors may still bias policy updates. Improving feedback reliability without substantially increasing inference cost remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 计算机 SD依赖于GUI分析器的可靠性,它既为自我消化提供了特权指导,也为对由此产生的监督进行分级值判断提供了特权指导. 任一输出的错误都会扭曲OPSD信号,当两种输出都不可靠时,值门就无法完全解决这个问题. 因此,如附录C.3所述,我们的设计兼顾了反馈可靠性与专家模型调用的成本:精细的GUI分析器大大减少了获取反馈的成本,同时保持了强烈的可靠性。 此外,OPSD与轨迹级GRPO一起作为一个辅助目标,其贡献由很小的损失系数控制。 这降低了偶尔不可靠的反馈对总体优化的影响,尽管系统性分析器错误仍然可能偏向政策更新. 提高反馈的可靠性,而不大大增加推论成本,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

We perform full-parameter policy optimization while keeping the visual encoder frozen. Training tasks are shuffled before sampling. The GUI analyzer uses a temperature of 0.0 0.0 and a maximum response length of 4,096 tokens. Table 7 lists the optimization hyperparameters.

blocks.en: Our fully asynchronous training framework is adapted from OpenClaw-RL Wang et al. (2026b) . Both ordinary and privileged contexts are rescored using the same snapshot of the current training policy. The resulting log-probability gaps and value-gate weights are computed once and cached. Updated parameters are synchronized to rollout workers immediately after each training step, while samples collected under earlier policy versions are retained. The SFT and online RL experiments each use one node equipped with 16 PPUs (96 GB). During online RL, the rollout and training engines each use 8 PPUs.

C.3 分析器质量评价

blocks.en: We randomly hold out 1% of the annotated samples as a validation set, comprising 341 samples excluded from SFT. We compare the base Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking model with the fine-tuned GUI analyzer on agreement with the expert’s step-level value judgments and output format validity. The valid output rate measures the proportion of responses that satisfy the required format and can be parsed by our extraction rules.
blocks.zh: 我们随机抽取1%的注解样本作为验证组,其中341个样本被排除在SFT之外. 我们比较了基础的Qwen3-VL-8B-思维模型和精细的GUI分析器,这些分析器与专家的阶级值判断和输出格式有效性一致. 有效的输出率衡量符合要求格式的响应比例,并且可以通过我们的提取规则进行解析.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 9 , SFT increases expert agreement from 29.9% to 85.3% and the valid output rate from 41.6% to 99.7%. These results highlight the importance of task-specific fine-tuning for both value assessment and structured output generation. The fine-tuned analyzer provides more reliable supervision while avoiding expensive expert API calls during online training.
blocks.zh: 如表9所示,SFT将专家协议从29.9%增加到85.3%,并将有效产出率从41.6%增加到99.7%。 这些结果突出了针对具体任务的微调对价值评估和结构化产出产生的重要性。 微调分析器提供更可靠的监督,同时避免在线培训中昂贵的专家API呼叫.

D.1 数据集

blocks.en: OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) is an interactive benchmark for evaluating agents on real-world computer tasks, including web browsing, document editing, file management, and workflows spanning multiple applications. Each task provides an initial environment configuration and an execution-based evaluator that checks task completion. Our experiments use 361 tasks, with 222 tasks used for online training and in-domain evaluation. The remaining 139 tasks from the Chrome and Multiple Apps categories are reserved for OOD evaluation.
blocks.zh: OSWorld-Verified(Xie et al., 2024)是一个互动的基准,用于评价代理商在现实世界计算机任务,包括网页浏览,文档编辑,文件管理,以及跨越多个应用程序的工作流程. 每项任务都提供初步的环境配置和基于执行的评估,以检查任务完成情况。 我们的实验使用了361项任务,其中222项任务用于在线培训和域内评价. 其余139项来自Chrome和多类apps类别的任务保留给OD评价.

blocks.en: WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) evaluates computer-use agents in real Windows environments. The benchmark contains 154 tasks covering document editing, web browsing, system operations, coding, and multimedia applications, with task success assessed by execution-based evaluators. We use WindowsAgentArena for cross-platform evaluation of policies trained on OSWorld-Verified, without additional training on Windows tasks.
blocks.zh: Windows 代理服务器 (Bonatti等人,2024年)评价真实Windows环境中的计算机使用代理. 该基准包含154项任务,包括文件编辑、网页浏览、系统操作、编码和多媒体应用程序,任务成功与否由执行评价员评估。 我们使用WindowsAgentArena对经过OSWorld-Verific化培训的政策进行跨平台评价,而无需额外的Windows任务培训.
D.2 基线

blocks.en: We conduct experiments with two 8B-scale models: • Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) is a general-purpose vision-language model with multimodal reasoning capabilities. We use it to evaluate ComputerSD on a general-purpose backbone. • EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) is a computer-use model post-trained on synthetic interaction experience. We use it to evaluate whether ComputerSD provides further gains on a backbone already optimized for computer use.

blocks.en: We compare ComputerSD with three baseline methods: • Prompt-only method. We use the expert model to generate trajectory-level guidance for each training task. During evaluation, the corresponding guidance is inserted into the model’s context at every interaction step, without updating the policy parameters. • Outcome-only GRPO. This baseline computes trajectory-level group-relative advantages using only the outcome rewards provided by the environment verifiers. • GRPO with PRM. This baseline uses the GUI analyzer as a process reward model, retaining only its step-level scores. We sum the scores over all steps in each trajectory and add the outcome reward to obtain a combined trajectory reward, which is then used to compute trajectory-level group-relative advantages.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了ComputerSD与三种基准方法: —— 即时方法. 我们利用专家模型为每项培训任务提供轨迹指导。 在评价期间,在不更新政策参数的情况下,在每个互动步骤中,将相应的指导插入模型的背景。 • 仅注重结果的GPRO。 这一基线只利用环境核查员提供的结果奖励计算出轨迹级别的群体相对优势。 • PRM的GPRO。 这个基线使用GUI分析器作为过程奖励模型,只保留其阶级分数. 我们汇总每个轨迹中所有步骤的分数,并加上结果奖励,以获得综合的轨迹奖励,然后用来计算轨迹级别的团体相对优势.

附录E 结果

blocks.en: We compare ComputerSD with two additional baselines, the prompt-only method and GRPO with PRM, using Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking as the base model to further examine the benefits of incorporating real-time guidance through online self-distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了ComputerSD与另外两个基线,即即即时方法和GPRO与PRM,使用Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking作为基础模型,通过在线自我消化进一步审查纳入实时指导的好处.

blocks.en: Table 10 reports their performance on OSWorld-Verified. The prompt-only method improves the success rate from 33.8% to 34.6%, suggesting that injecting guidance into the context without updating the policy provides limited gains. GRPO with PRM achieves 37.4% but remains below ComputerSD at 39.8%. Although this baseline incorporates step-level value assessments, a scalar reward alone cannot fully exploit the real-time environment feedback.
blocks.zh: 表10在OSWorld-Verificed上报告了它们的绩效. 速效方法将成功率从33.8%提高到34.6%,这表明在不更新政策的情况下注入指导可带来的收益有限。 使用PRM的GRPO实现37.4%,但仍低于计算机自定义的39.8%。 虽然这一基线包括了阶梯级价值评估,但光是分级奖励并不能充分利用实时环境反馈。

blocks.en: After reaching the correct settings page, the GRPO-trained policy attempts to change the interval without first enabling the AutoRecovery checkbox. It then clicks OK and declares success though the input has not taken effect. In contrast, the ComputerSD-trained policy first enables the checkbox, then changes the interval and confirms the settings. This comparison suggests that ComputerSD internalizes a better understanding of task states from real-time feedback, rather than merely memorizing action sequences.
blocks.zh: 在到达正确的设置页面后,GRPO训练的政策试图改变间隔而不首先启用自动恢复复选框. 然后单击“确定”并宣布成功,尽管输入尚未生效。 相比之下,计算机SD训练策略首先启用复选框,然后更改间隔,确认设置. 这种比较表明,计算机SD通过实时反馈,而不仅仅是记忆动作序列,将任务状态的更好理解内在化.

blocks.en: Both policies locate the profile name field, select the existing text, and enter “Thomas.” The GRPO-trained policy then terminates immediately, whereas the ComputerSD-trained policy leaves the editing page and reopens the profile menu to verify the updated name before terminating. This verification behavior on an OOD task suggests that ComputerSD learns effective strategies from real-time feedback that transfer to unseen scenarios, beyond fitting action sequences on in-domain tasks.
blocks.zh: 两种策略都定位配置文件名称字段,选择现有的文本,并输入“Thomas”。 GRPO训练后政策立即终止,而ComputerSD训练后政策则离开编辑页面,重新打开配置菜单,以验证更新后的名字,然后终止. 在OOD任务上的这种校验行为表明,计算机数据交换系统从实时反馈中学习到有效的策略,这些反馈转移到看不见的情景中,超越了适合域内任务动作序列的范围.
